$comment: Accepted dependency advisories. CI (`scripts/audit-check.mjs`) fails on any
high/critical advisory NOT listed here, and fails on any listed exception
whose `expires` date has passed — so an exception can never quietly become
permanent. Every entry must state why the vulnerable code path is
An exception accepts the advisory ids it lists, and only those: a new advisory
on the same package fails the gate until it is reviewed and added by id.
